content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a challenge with reading a value from [product_name]_1 to [product_name]_2 and [product_name]_3 across a network. My setup includes three [product_name] version [version_no], on [product_name] software [version_no]. There's a retentive timer in [product_name]_1, and I want to access its value from [product_name]_2 and [product_name]_3, but so far no success. Is there any network block, like NW/NI/NQ, that lets you transfer a word value between devices? Any suggestions would be much appreciated. Thanks and regards.
Which specific timer value do you want to transfer? Is it the current time, the remaining time, the elapsed time, or perhaps the on-delay value?
Hi [user_name], apologies for not clarifying earlier. I am looking to retrieve the current running time from the retentive timer.
Check the attached file for more details.
You can configure a virtual value in [product_name]_1 and access it from [product_name]_2 and [product_name]_3. Review the help section for "VM Mapping" in [product_name] software for guidance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working together to determine how to share the live value of a retentive timer between multiple [product_name] modules across a network. There's a noticeable lack of clarity around inter-device value transfer, especially for real-time timer data. The mention of 'VM Mapping' hints at useful features that may not be immediately obvious to users, highlighting the need for clearer resources or documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and direct way to read and transmit live timer values, such as the current time from a retentive timer in one [product_name] module to others within the same network.
